speaker: The Chairman
text: Main and Development Estimates of Expenditure of Singapore for the financial year 1 April 2017 to 31 March 2018, contained in Paper Cmd 8 of 2017.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I must remind hon Members that the total time for discussion of each Head of Expenditure includes the replies from the front bench.

speaker: The Chairman
text: With the assistance of the digital timer in the Chamber, I trust that hon Members will be able to keep to the speech times indicated against their amendments.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I would urge hon Members both from the back and front benches to adhere to their time limits, as I will be very stringent in my time-keeping.

speaker: The Chairman
text: But I say that every year, so it is nothing new.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I shall deal first with the Heads of Expenditure in respect of which amendments stand on the Order Paper Supplement.
